integrity: Symbolic transform coefficients and independent numerical moment integrations reproduced; mathematical asymptotic proof uses integrating factor and monotone Tauberian theorem, not simulation.
scientific_limitations: Proves fixed-parameter mean-square asymptotics for 0<theta<=1, not a functional limit or uniform near-critical scaling; original process and Laplace transform are prior work; marginal logarithmic behavior is analogous to the known elephant walk; broader implicit priority coverage remains possible.
title: Critical logarithmic spreading and exact diffusion amplitudes for reinforced run–rest transport
